## Post

ByteDance just dropped an open source AI agent that can control your entire computer just by looking at it.

It’s called UI-TARS Desktop.

1,300 GitHub stars in a single day.
29.4k total.
Here’s what it actually does 👇

You type in plain English.
It sees your screen.
It acts.

Real examples from the repo:
→ “Book the earliest flight from San Jose to New York on Priceline”
AI opens the browser, navigates Priceline, finds the flight, books it.
You just watch.

→ “Open VS Code autosave and set delay to 500ms”

AI opens VS Code settings, finds the exact toggle, changes it.
Done.

→ “Check the latest open GitHub issue for this project”
AI opens GitHub, navigates the repo, reads the issue.
No clicks from you.

This isn’t a chatbot.

This is an agent that SEES and ACTS.
Under the hood:

🧠 Vision-Language Model for screen understanding
🖱️ Precise mouse + keyboard control
🌐 Hybrid browser agent - GUI + DOM combined
🔐 Fully local processing - nothing leaves your machine
🖥️ Works on Windows, macOS, and browser

And there’s Agent TARS on top:
A full multimodal agent CLI that can:
→ book hotels
→ generate charts
→ run shell commands
→ automate workflows

All through natural language.

One command to try it:

npx @agent-tars/cli@latest

ByteDance quietly built one of the most impressive open source computer-use agents out there.

Check it out👇

## Post

UI-TARS-desktop, an open-source multimodal AI agent developed by #ByteDance (the company behind #TikTok). It allows users to automate desktop tasks using natural language commands, running 100% locally without internet access after setup.

Key Details
1. Core Capabilities: The agent captures screenshots, interprets them with vision-language models, and performs precise mouse/keyboard actions. It can open apps, navigate menus, fill forms, browse websites, and handle complex workflows, all via chat-like instructions.
2. Privacy & Local Execution: Everything processes on your machine for enhanced privacy and offline use.
3. Supported Models: Primarily ByteDance's UI-TARS-1.5-7B (available on Hugging Face), with support for related Seed-VL models.
4. Platform: Cross-platform focus, with strong demos on macOS and Windows.
5. Project Status: Launched in early 2025, actively maintained, ~25.5k GitHub stars. 

Resources
GitHub Repo → https://t.co/qz1RKPfOc4 (installation guides in docs).
Model → https://t.co/YhdDnFulGu.

Caution: This tool grants full desktop control, so use it carefully (e.g., in isolated environments) to avoid unintended actions. As open-source code from a major company, it can be audited, but powerful automation always carries risks.

ByteDance Releases UI-TARS-1.5: An Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Built upon a Powerful Vision-Language Model

ByteDance has released UI-TARS-1.5, an updated version of its multimodal agent framework focused on graphical user interface (GUI) interaction and game environments. Designed as a vision-language model capable of perceiving screen content and performing interactive tasks, UI-TARS-1.5 delivers consistent improvements across a range of GUI automation and game reasoning benchmarks. Notably, it surpasses several leading models—including OpenAI’s Operator and Anthropic’s Claude 3.7—in both accuracy and task completion across multiple environments......
